scientific_integrity: Proof includes all vertex counts and part profiles; exact symbolic inequalities establish necessity and sufficiency. Finite rational verification is supplementary, not a proof of universal quantifiers. The work has not been independently audited.
scientific_limitations: Linear autonomous unweighted connected complete multipartite graph generators only; endpoint entrywise positivity, not stage positivity or universal SSP guarantees. No claims for arbitrary graphs, nonuniform weights, or nonlinear evolution. Published-priority assessment remains conditional on the inspected sources and has not been independently validated.
title: Exact positivity radii and an order-three reversal for Taylor Runge–Kutta diffusion on complete multipartite graphs
